thread:
Ravi: Heads-up: the API team is debating whether to keep REST façades for all internal services or move to gRPC-only with a thin gateway. Main constraints: browser SDK ergonomics, telemetry fidelity, and per-tenant quota accounting. Thoughts?

Claire: Strong preference for gRPC internal-first. Benefits: typed contracts, smaller payloads, better perf. That said we need a plan for browser clients and third-party integrations. A gateway that supports transcode + header-driven routing seems fine.

Jo: +1 on typed contracts, but we shouldn't hide quota semantics. If gateway auto-transcodes JSON -> proto we must still emit accurate token/quota usage upstream (no double-counting). Need telemetry fields that show input_format and billed_units.

Ravi: Exactly. Proposal: keep canonical proto models in repo; run a transcode layer at edge. Two routing modes: 1) proto-preferred (default) 2) json-fallback for browsers. Allow per-tenant percentage rollouts. Console needs to show routed_by, top validation failures, and estimated unit-cost delta when falling back to json (due to cache misses).

Claire: Also, avoid silently changing semantics when fields mismatch. If JSON contains types that don't match proto, return 400 with code PROTO_MISMATCH and log a fallback_reason. No silent coercion.

Jo: Telemetry sketch: attributes: transport (grpc/json), decision (policy|override|fallback), proto_validation (ok|error), billed_tokens. Emit both in logs and traces. Add Prometheus counters for fallback_reasons.

Ravi: For gateway pattern: implement Envoy filter to check X-RW-Transport header (if present) and policy allowlist. Example pseudo-config:
```
- name: transport_override
  match: { header_present: X-RW-Transport }
  allow_if: tenant.flag("transport_override") == true
```
Edge will annotate request with transport.choice and forward to appropriate upstream cluster.

Claire: UX: Rollout card should have quick facts: current % grpc vs json, last 1h latency delta, top 3 failure reasons, estimated monthly cost impact if json stays. Single-click rollback toggles tenant flag and sends notification.

Jo: Also add auto-rollback: if proto_validation_error_rate > 0.3% or billed_tokens delta > 10% over 1h -> revert and create incident. Make thresholds configurable per-rollout.

ops-bot: gateway/transcode v3 -> staging succeeded :white_check_mark:

Ravi: I'll write an RFC with the policy DSL, telemetry spec, and Console mock. Claire/Jo please review for proto semantics and billing edges.

Claire: Will review. Happy to sketch the proto validation response spec.

Jo: I'll add prometheus metrics names and a tracing span name transport.selection.
